2016Journal article

Reinforcement learning

Neural networks meet tree search in Go

Policy and value networks strengthened search in a difficult board game.

David Silver and colleagues

The contribution

AlphaGo combined neural networks for selecting moves and evaluating positions with a tree-search procedure. The system integrated supervised learning from expert play and reinforcement learning to reach a major milestone in computer Go.

What this does not establish

This paper reports the match against Fan Hui. It does not report the later March 2016 Lee Sedol match, and it concerns a specific game.

Why this date?

The paper appeared on 27 January 2016 and reports the October 2015 Fan Hui match.

This entry follows the linked publication. Read the source and date conventions.
